usedFor: CaptureKit pulls page text and Markdown with “Capture Page Content” and images of pages with “Take Webpage Screenshot”.

bestTemplate.name: “Capture Page Content” in CaptureKit
bestTemplate.why: Page text as Markdown is easy to read, store and pass on to an AI agent.

watchOut: AI agents run on a schedule or when you ask, so a page is captured then, not when it changes.
